verses.1: Adam was intimate with his wife Eve, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain. She said, "I have gotten a man with the help of the LORD."
verses.2: She also gave birth to his brother Abel. Abel kept flocks, and Cain worked the ground.
verses.3: In the course of time Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.
verses.4: Abel also brought an offering from the firstborn of his flock and from their fat portions. The LORD looked with favor on Abel and his offering,
verses.5: but on Cain and his offering He did not look with favor. Cain became very angry, and his face fell.
verses.6: The LORD said to Cain, "Why are you angry, and why has your face fallen?
verses.7: If you do what is right, will you not be accepted? But if you do not do what is right, sin is crouching at the door. It desires to have you, but you must rule over it."
verses.8: Cain spoke to his brother Abel. And when they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel and killed him.
verses.9: The LORD said to Cain, "Where is your brother Abel?" He said, "I do not know. Am I my brother's keeper?"
verses.10: The LORD said, "What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood is crying out to Me from the ground.
verses.11: Now you are cursed from the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother's blood from your hand.
verses.12: When you work the ground, it will no longer yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth."
verses.13: Cain said to the LORD, "My punishment is greater than I can bear.
verses.14: Today You are driving me from the land, and I will be hidden from Your presence. I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth, and whoever finds me will kill me."
verses.15: The LORD said to him, "Not so. If anyone kills Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold." And the LORD put a mark on Cain so that no one who found him would kill him.
verses.16: Then Cain went away from the presence of the LORD and settled in the land of Nod, east of Eden.
verses.17: Cain was intimate with his wife, and she conceived and gave birth to Enoch. Cain built a city and named it after his son Enoch.
verses.18: To Enoch was born Irad, and Irad fathered Mehujael, and Mehujael fathered Methushael, and Methushael fathered Lamech.
verses.19: Lamech took two wives. The name of the one was Adah and the name of the other was Zillah.
verses.20: Adah gave birth to Jabal; he was the father of those who live in tents and raise livestock.
verses.21: His brother's name was Jubal; he was the father of all who play the harp and flute.
verses.22: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal-cain, who forged all kinds of cutting tools from bronze and iron. The sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
verses.23: Lamech said to his wives, "Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, listen to what I say. I have killed a man for wounding me, a young man for striking me.
verses.24: If Cain is avenged sevenfold, then Lamech seventy-sevenfold."
verses.25: Adam was intimate with his wife again, and she gave birth to a son and named him Seth, saying, "God has appointed another offspring for me in place of Abel, since Cain killed him."
verses.26: To Seth also a son was born, and he named him Enosh. At that time people began to call on the name of the LORD.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
